name: Portal da Transparencia API de dados
tier_rationale: Government body (Controladoria-Geral da Uniao; A8: government bodies are trusted); P237 provider tier trusted, the same operator as transparencia ('trusted - Portal da Transparencia (CGU)', P250 cond 5).

reliability.justification: Official CGU API (company records, sanctions, contracts, convenios); rows that do not contain the queried CNPJ mean the filter was ignored -> ERROR, never findings (P237 cond 6).

transparencia.description: Portal da Transparencia (CGU) API key (chave-api-dados header)
transparencia.plan_hint: free key registered with the team's institutional gov.br account, never a personal or borrowed key (P237 cond 1); CGU open data, business-compatible (free_plan_business_use true)

api_dados.title: Portal da Transparencia API de dados (pessoa-juridica, CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, acordos-leniencia, contratos)

terms.quote: CGU open data: key_plans business-compatible (free_plan_business_use true per the registry evidence).

api_dados.notes: Research C0543 terms 'Open government data (CGU); free key by e-mail registration (gov.br login) at portaldatransparencia.gov.br/api-de-dados/cadastrar-email' / 'Brazilian federal open data' / 'CGU / LAI open data; free key by email.' The OpenAPI document (api.portaldatransparencia.gov.br/v3/api-docs) declares the chave-api-dados header. Key in that header only, never logged or stored in URLs (AR01); 401 'Chave de API nao informada' = NEEDS_KEY (P237 cond 2). Never a CPF or NIS parameter (/pessoa-fisica, /ceaf?cpfSancionado=, /peps?cpf=, benefit endpoints): rule 4 (P237 cond 3). Pagination <= 3 pages, max_requests 10 per entity (P237 cond 7). Used by portal_transparencia_api.

notes: Seeded for batch p2-G10-1 (P237), split from transparencia (own key, per-key budget). Quota: 'the documented 90 req/min (06:00-23:59) and 300 req/min (00:00-05:59) per key' (P237 cond 7; research C0543 'per portal docs'): the block uses the stricter daytime figure, 1.5/s per key (budget 1.2/s), with min_interval 1 s; the API page answers a CAPTCHA to scripts, so it was not re-fetched on 2026-11-26. 429 = RATE_LIMITED. Key 'transparencia' is also in the legacy config.KNOWN_KEYS table (alias PORTAL_TRANSPARENCIA_KEY); config.key_registry() merges the aliases. .br hosts default to Accept-Language pt-BR.
